_comment: Ratchet baseline for check_no_app_names.py. These counts may only go DOWN. The target for all four is zero: content reaches it at extraction (stage 7), imports at the AppSpec seams (stage 4), home_path_sites when every path in $HOME comes from config. `watched` is sticky on purpose, so an app that leaves the catalog is still scanned for leftovers. NOTE 2026-08-27: content/imports/literals were re-pinned at a HIGHER measured value on this date, once, because the scan area was widened from six directories to the tracked tree and an app-content file stopped short-circuiting out of all four checks. Nobody added those lines; the gate could not previously see them. See `raised` below for the full reason, which prints on every run until each count comes back down. 2026-09-04, ticket d65244c4: the FIRST count that fell for the reason the target exists -- health left the repo. content 131->125 and literals 348->342 are its three backend modules, its three frontend files and the three assertions that moved to the app's own tests. Six more apps follow; each one lowers these two the same way. Notes followed the same day (668a18f3): content 125->115, imports 15->13, and the 102 lines of its layout that lived in the platform's design kit went with it. Then budget+finance (2e958c37, 1fac9c03) and commute+location (58136c09, 26dbe9b3), extracted as PAIRS because each pair imports across itself: content 115->56, imports 13->1, literals 341->322. Then birds (1db9d9db/9e554582) and wearables, which finished it: content 0 and imports 0, measured 2026-09-04. NO TRACKED FILE IN THIS REPO IS APP SOURCE AND NO PLATFORM FILE IMPORTS AN APP MODULE. literal_sites is 299 and is the whole remaining job; most of it is the generated OpenAPI schema and tests. Two of the four counts have reached their target and may now only be held: a rise in content_files or import_sites is app source coming BACK, which is the defect this whole effort exists to end.

content_files.because: Two legitimate raises, both of the shape the header calls correct: more app-source files VISIBLE, fewer platform files secretly depending on one. (1) 106->121, carried since 2026-09-01/02 and never pinned: de-hardcoding the two registries moved app declarations out of platform files into app-owned ones, and 959a264e widened the roster from a subset to all 9 apps, so an app that had never been scanned (gengui) started counting. (2) 121->131 on 2026-09-04, ticket df91b7c4: the ten modules that were app code hiding behind a platform name now carry their app's name (routes/services/owntracks, environment, categorizer, plaid_webhook, plaid_store, plaid_verify plus two backend/scripts one-offs), and the path classifier learned that backend/scripts/<app>_*.py is app source for the same reason routes/ and services/ are. Both moves bought the counts that matter: import_sites 24->17->15 and literal_sites 479->354->348. The nightly categorize loop also moved from finance's declaration to budget's, where the function it calls and the store it writes both live.
content_files.resolved: Both raises came back down and then to ZERO on 2026-09-04 when the seven apps left the repo. Kept for the record: the raise was the gate learning to SEE app source, and seeing it is what let it be removed.
